findings: JpegPatcher removes all contiguous leading APP0..APP15 segments, not only EXIF. This also removes leading ICC APP2, Adobe APP14 and other application metadata. Consequently SameContents hashes a transformed JPEG byte stream, not exact encoded bytes or decoded color-managed pixels. No JPEG runtime comparison was executed.

APP segments after a non-APP marker are retained, making normalized output depend on marker ordering. Segment lengths and read EOF are not validated; malformed declarations are consumed with repeated ReadByte calls. Source observations only.

GetFileHash allocates an entire patched JPEG in MemoryStream, with no input-size cap or cancellation during transformation/hash. It opens the file once for signature detection and again for hashing without a stable identity stamp.

DuplicateFile stores immutable length/creation/modification observations but caches a mutable hash. Refresh only checks File.Exists and mark/lock state; it does not refresh size/timestamps/hash or distinguish file replacement. No physical file identity or equality override is defined in this class.

SearchDirectory preserves caller-supplied FullName without canonicalization. Extensions.IsSameAsOrSubdirectoryOf does append a directory separator, avoiding the simple sibling-prefix bug, but uses OrdinalIgnoreCase on all platforms and does not resolve symlinks.

README explicitly presents a duplicate file cleaner with optional filters; no perceptual-image semantics or normalized-JPEG recipe is described there. Main UI defaults and option naming remain to inspect.
Project targets net8.0 and references Avalonia packages plus a bundled AppUpdater DLL; its source is absent from this project file. No third-party package or opaque binary executed.
adoption: No upstream code adopted. Preserve separation of encoded-byte equality, normalized-container equality, and color-managed pixel equality.
